sentence_stem: I didn't reply to your text message yesterday because
full_sentence: I didn't reply to your text message yesterday because my phone battery was empty.
acceptable_variants: I was busy with work all day.

options.text: so I sent you a photo.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a reason for the missing reply. 'So I sent you a photo' describes a later action and does not explain why you did not reply.
'Although' shows contrast, not cause. The stem needs a reason that explains the missing reply.
'And then' adds a new event. It does not give a reason for not replying to the message.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the first part of the sentence. Students should check whether the option explains the cause rather than adding a contrast or a new event.
translation: Nie odpisałem na twoją wiadomość wczoraj, ponieważ bateria w moim telefonie była rozładowana.
